visual_review.identity_and_anatomy: Six full frost-slime poses retain the angry cyan face, pale jelly highlights and attached ice spikes. Clear low squash, mid-height expansion, tall recovery and lateral body deformation create distinct locomotion phases without added feet. No detached ice spray.
limitations: Strict 70-percent occupancy and 15-percent padding targets were not consistently met. Figures remain complete and separate; source not repaired solely for nominal cell boundary differences.
Fine semitransparent edge pixels require parent packing review; no generated pixels were repainted or alpha-cleaned here.
Loop, runtime scale, integration and game verification remain parent-owned and unverified.
